title: Hati Nadhifu (Theme 2: Shambani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child forms each letter from the right starting point, sits it on the line, leaves a finger space after each word, and checks before the clean copy.

floor.prerequisite: Holds the pencil well and writes his own name.
floor.question: Andika jina lako.

representations: letter shapes traced in sand or air
a model passage on the board
steps: Write each letter on the line.
Leave a space after each word.
Check and write the clean copy.
contexts: copying the date from the board
writing a note to a parent

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the line neatly and reads it back.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inaanza kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi na jina la mtu au mahali huanza kwa herufi kubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Kwa nini herufi hii ni kubwa katikati ya neno?
misconceptions.repair: Herufi kubwa iko mwanzoni tu; nyingine ni ndogo.
Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.

checks.question: Andika vizuri: Juma na Amina wanalima shambani.
